**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Many thanks for this paper on Elisha,[^1] it is so exactly the thing that it makes me feel what an excellent collaborateur [you](../persons.html#1160) are! I believe your next is the Babylonish destruction with an eve to the final one and of course the Anti-type, but you always take the very course I like best in your comments.

[^1]: The article ‘Elisha’s Miracles’ with the initials F.M.P. appeared in N0. 22 of the [Monthly Paper on Sunday Teaching](../others.html#81) headed ‘Tenth Sunday after Trinity.

Her ‘Naaman and the leprosy’ appeared in No 23 and her ”Destruction of Jerusalem” in No. 24.
